title: REQ · Default state and every action of the real store are asserted in one suite
summary: A single suite asserts all default fields and each action including repeated toggles and field independence
description: Context: existing tests split drawer/modal, sound/settings and hook subscription, and none asserts every default together or that actions are functions. Desired behavior: a consolidated suite covers defaults and each action, including double toggle returning to the default and openModal replacing then closeModal clearing the modal. Expected result: any regression in a default or action fails a named test. Why: complete coverage for SG-1.2.3.
acceptance_criteria: Given the initial state, when read, then all four fields hold their defaults and five actions are functions.
Given each toggle action called twice, when state is read after each call, then the value flips then returns to its default, leaving other fields unchanged.
Given openModal('contribution') then closeModal(), when state is read after each, then modal is 'contribution' then null.
technical_constraints: Real store only; reset via getInitialState between tests
definition_of_done: All default and action assertions pass
